reviews.text:
BUCKLE UP everyone! Because this place should have zero ratings and every low review is very true, avoid at all cost!

Do not go here if you are trying to get papers work done for your little ones travelling abroad. I been using this place for my cats for the past months and never had a problem until now, which is the most saddest part now realizing that every 1 star review for this place is true and heavily reflects on their practices and service.

The service to get paper work done for your pets to travel is around 1.2k by the way and with that amount of money you would think they would know what paper work is correct or not. They made me feel stupid and yes OF COURSE I’m the stupid one I’m not the vet here or went to school for this and for a service they claim they provide for so much money they should have all the knowledge and be educated with. Also at one point when we were arguing back and forth with the paper work one of them told me they have been doing this for 20 years (CLEARLY NOT).

First they told me this needs to be on legal paper and almost made me go buy legal paper for them, then turns out they all a sudden had legal paper? But don’t worry they printed documents that were completely wrong!

The whole process should have been 3hrs ended up being 8 hours from travelling back and forth to the CFIA with the papers the VETS provided were wrong!!!!!! When I came back with the correct paper from the CFIA they were kind enough to print, Spadina Hospital tried to charge me 250 again to resign the papers they signed wrong. I am very thankful for my sisters being there for me and standing up for me, but this whole situation felt like a humiliation bully ritual by people that peaked from highschool.

Especially the girl with the green hair, for being the first person to see and represent the establishment she is the most incompetent, rude, and dismissive employee I have ever come across, I don’t understand how she even works as front desk. She also doesn’t know how to read perhaps she should grab a pair of glasses! When this clinic did the papers from for us and when we came back she tried to make us write the forms by ourselves and practically kick us out of the vet. It only took one phone call to the CFIA and openly talking loud or things that the vet told us to do they told us NOT to do that. Keep in mind the girl in the green hair just did the papers not an hour and a half ago and asked where to stamp the paper when it clearly said stamp?

Not only was the first papers done wrong with a service they charge highly for, but DR. Luke and another worker had to call out one of the girls filling out our papers for our cats twice (one for the wrong date for the vaccines and one for not filling out important sections.

Please for the love of god go somewhere else when it comes to paper work maybe other things is okay, but beware tons of hidden cost. But if you want to come here be prepared to be treated like your really stupid have short replies and snappy at you! (Especially from the girl with the green hair!)

If I could rate this place zero stars after this experience I would :)

Please do your research and make many’s phone calls if you do choose to come here. I was a repeat customer but never again, would genuinely never recommend.

Please reset your front desk people.
This vet place is horrible!

I am writing to express my extreme disappointment with the care my dog, Shiro, recently received. Shiro has been a patient at your clinic for over 2.5 years and suffers from predictable, seasonal environmental allergies that affect his paws every year.
Two months ago, I brought Shiro in just as his paw symptoms were starting. Unfortunately, the veterinarian misdiagnosed him because they failed to review his medical history. It was only at the very end of our recent follow-up appointment—after his paws had severely worsened—that the doctor actually read Shiro's previous clinical notes. I had to personally point out that we were there for the exact same issue I brought him in for two months prior.
Because the clinic failed to review his history and provide the correct medication initially, his condition deteriorated. Now, I am being charged upwards of $450 for a "new" diagnosis to fix a mistake that should have been prevented. To make matters worse, after realizing I was upset during checkout, the doctor came out to the lobby to take photos of Shiro's feet in what felt like a panicked attempt to overcorrect.
This is unacceptable clinical practice. I will be paying today's bill under protest to ensure my dog gets immediate care, but I will also be filing a formal complaint with the College of Veterinarians of Ontario (CVO) regarding this lack of continuity of care.
Absolutely loved the compassion and care I recieved here. They were great in this difficult time.

Called and ask how much a needle drainage would be for an ear haematoma for my dog and they couldn’t give me any sort of price over the phone. They demanded that I had to come in person and be blindsided by the price. Not sure how a business can run like this if people would like to know a price upfront before committing to something.
Called star vet Bathurst and king after and they gave me an estimate in 2 minutes

We’re sorry to hear that you were unhappy with your experience. We strive to treat all our clients with professionalism and respect, and we expect the same courtesy toward our staff. Please contact our team at staff@spadinavet.com to help us resolve this matter.
Mistakes with paperwork, tried to charge for fixes, extremely rude

Thank you for your feedback, Jennie. We regret that your experience didn't meet expectations. We strive to treat all our clients with professionalism and respect, and we expect the same courtesy toward our staff. Please contact our team at staff@spadinavet.comto help us resolve this matter.

I took my elderly cat whose health was declining in for an emergency visit. He ultimately ended up passing away. This was THREE YEARS AGO. since then this clinic has continued to send text reminders that he is due for a wellness check up even though I personally called to ask they stop sending me them because it was upsetting my family. They sent another postcard even after my call a month ago and I had to call AGAIN to ask them to stop sending reminders for my deceased cat. These “reminders” are so upsetting to receive and is the reason for this review.

The vets and vet techs at Spadina Animal Hospital genuinely care about their patients and the caretakers of those patients. They are kind, patient, and definitely love animals. I am very grateful that I found this animal hospital, and I would wholeheartedly recommend it to others.

In 2022, my cat passed away due to heart failure. She threw up on Tuesday afternoon and by Thursday afternoon, she had passed away. Before taking my cat to the animal hospital, Dr. Guirguis took a look and told me she had a "clear kidney issue" and reprimanded me for not addressing the issue sooner and blamed me for not taking care of her properly. Even though everything had happened in only 2 days. At the hospital, they told me nothing could have been done to prevent the failure. For a long time, I blamed myself for her death due to the encounter with Dr Guirguis and only felt like it wasn't my fault after going to grief counselling. The hospital also told me that a report would be sent to my vet and I could make an appointment with them to talk further. I contacted Spadina Animal Hospital multiple times to schedule an appointment to go over the report and it was always met with excuses or reasons why the appointment could not be scheduled. But of course they will gladly schedule appointments very very quickly to take your money from you. Based on the disrespectful behavior I encountered, I don't trust that they would have my pets best interests at heart or if they would just tell me false information in order to get more money. I will definately be switching vets. Interesting how they have the lowest rating compared to other vets in the area, so I must not be the only one that has encountered such poor service with a steep price.

UPDATE: With the last visit with Spadina Animal Hospital, I was told that one of my cat's teeth issues were "severe". Now that I've taken my cat to another vet and told that his teeth issues are "mild" and given actual practical ways to minimize his issues, it's become more clear that my instinct to switch vets was correct.
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We're glad you had a positive experience with our team at the clinic. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

very happy with my experience with Spadina Animal Hospital! Dr. Luke was super transparent about his suggestions for my cat and her yearly testing, and I received her testing results promptly. Will continue to come here for her care!
Bring your best friend to another vet. This is not the place. Run.
Stephen, your 5-star review means a lot to us! We're thrilled you had a positive experience. Looking forward to your next visit!
Highly recommended. I have no regrets bringing Hershey and Mocha to Spadina Animal Hospital. Thank you everyone for your kindness, and dedication! You are all appreciated!
Spadina animal clinic and Dr. Stuart have taken good care of our dogs for a few years. They respond all of my questions also have a print and puntual appointments and good rates.
Extremely displeased, we would never go there again

All the staff are incredibly wonderful and kind. I brought my 14 year old kitty here who was diagnosed with diabetes and the doctor was so gentle, kind, and sweet with him during his last days. He was very informative and were so thankful for his guidance and care during the whole process.

Dr Luke Stewart and his team provide great care to Opal. He always answers all of my questions (there are lots) and meets me where I’m at. Care is personalized. The front desk staff is also amazing. Highly recommend.

The staff and especially the doctors (Dr. Stewart and Dr. Pusong) at Spadina Animal Hospital have always been wonderful with Pepita, our little furball child. 🐶❤️

We actually found them during the pandemic, when Pepita developed a medical issue and we were desperately trying to find a veterinary clinic that could see her. After a long walk and searching and calling around, we decided to try Spadina Animal Hospital.  With just one call, they kindly accepted Pepita and arranged to see her the very next day. We have never forgotten how much that meant to us during such a difficult time.

That experience is why we have stayed with them ever since. From that day on, Spadina Animal Hospital has been our go-to clinic for all of Pepita’s medical needs. The staff and doctors are always kind, caring, and attentive, and we truly feel that our little girl is in good hands whenever we bring her in.

Thank you for taking such good care of Pepita through the years. We truly appreciate you and highly recommend Spadina Animal Hospital! 🐾❤️
Overall have been super disappointed with the last few visits. The quality of vets varies depending on the day. Some are salespeople; others care.
Angela, we notice your rating and would like to understand your experience better. Please reach out to our hospital team at +1 416-506-0100 to discuss any issues you encountered.
Everyone is always so kind and nice. You’ve squeezed in my dog when needed and have always given her the best care.
Dr. Gonzalez has taken care of my eldery cat for the last couple of years and has done a great job. The support staff is also wonderful. No complaints, highly recommended.
Your 5-star rating means a lot to us! We're thrilled you had a positive experience at our clinic. Looking forward to your next visit!
We regret that your experience with us didn't meet expectations. Please email at staff@spadinavet.com to discuss what went wrong and how we can improve.
compulsory consumption, no professional suggestions, just for money, too pricey
A wonderful caring pet hospital

Dr’s Stewart and Gonzalez are so patient and kind. They listen to me and establish a relationship with my dog. Options for care are fully explained. I appreciate their professionalism with personal warmth.

Terrible time management and a purely sales-driven approach. I had a scheduled appointment for my dog because he hurt his paw at the park. When we arrived, we had to wait 20 minutes because there were people ahead of us; they clearly don't respect appointment times. When the vet finally saw us and we explained what happened, all they did was try to charge me for everything. They started pushing an excessive amount of unnecessary services and products; it felt like their job was just to inflate the bill rather than care for my pet. They wanted to charge me nearly $1,000. In the end, I put my foot down and told them to only check his paw. I ended up paying $300 just for the consultation and medication. I don’t recommend them—they care more about money than the animals.

The team at Spadina Animal Hospital is kind, knowledgeable, and patient! I feel reassured every time I go and trust them fully with my cat's health. The vets and staff always take time to explain things, and answer all of my questions with kindness and compassion. I'd highly recommend them!

Have always come to this location for my cats exams and other needs. Any vets will be quite pricey in Toronto, the most important thing is how well they care for your pet and how you feel from the appointment and after. We have nothing but good things to say about Dr. Pusong and Dr.Stewart, my cat is a highly anxious cat but with prescribed gabapentin it is much more manageable but they always approached my cat with ease and care. We've also come here with my cat without calming medicine and it was good experience as well. Will be coming back again.
Steven, your 5-star rating means a lot to us! We're thrilled you had a positive experience. Looking forward to your next visit!
The team at Spadina Animal hospital is so lovely to work with, I trust them completely with my Coco
The have affordable and well treated animals

Absolutely lovely staff and great service. What I specifically love about this place was they were always available the days I needed and that consideration of treatment plan were always open, honest, upfront, and very detailed! I highly recommend.

Let me preface by saying Dr. Stewart and the reception staff are great.

However I would avoid Dr. Albert Gurgis.

He is not thorough whatsoever, with appointments not lasting more than 5 mins and inaccurate diagnoses.

I would still recommend Spadina animal hospital for its other much more helpful vets and staff.

Very bad experience. Reception people were very friendly, that was the only positive thing to be honest. The actual vet was extremely pushy trying to upsell a pet nutritionist, extra vaccines and followed up with an email & suggested supplies.

We are happy with our dog’s diet. I understand some vets are anti raw food but she was rude about it and relentless when I said I was not interested in this and just there for the rabies shot. It’s our dog and its up to us what we feed it and on us if there any problems. She was very condescending to
me and really didn't have time for what I was saying. Our dog is thriving and extremely healthy, an absolute unit of a dog. I'm honest we aren't interested in processed food, seed oils and garbage, we don't eat this ourselves. She was super rude and not interested in anything but making money and selling products. I will not go there again. The actual place was quite scruffy and run down also, could use an update and a good clean
We appreciate the 5-star review, Edgar! It's wonderful to know you had a great visit. We hope to welcome you and your furry friend back to our clinic soon!

Our review is based solely on our experience with one specific vet at this clinic, whom we saw twice.

Unfortunately, both visits felt incredibly transactional. She was excessively pushy about upselling services and products—like X-rays and medications.
We've since taken our two cats to a different clinic midtown and had a wonderfully different, much more compassionate experience. It’s deeply disappointing when a veterinarian acts more like a salesperson than a caring professional.

Because of this, I cannot recommend this location, especially to pet owners who are mindful of their budget but still want the best care for their animals.
Have been coming here for a very long time - many faces have changed.....but the spirit of caring and love remain constant....
Up front and honest about cost. Don’t talk you into buying their products. Quite willing to offer advice about alternative ie cheaper alternatives. Prompt,and  friendly
Thanks for the top rating! We're thrilled to know you were pleased with our care.
Always a delightful experience with the vets and office staff.

I took my cat here today to see Dr Luke. It was our first visit. I found the process of booking an appointment easy and Dr Luke was extremely attentive, giving my girl the most thorough examination I've ever seen. I could not fault the experience at all, particularly as I took her in to get a second opinion on her current condition. Dr Luke was very kind, attentive, considerate.

I love Spadina Animal Hospital. All the doctors and staff are exceptionally kind, educated, thoughtful, and organized. They always take the best care of Milo, and ensure we are proactive with her healthcare. Thank you!

our pomeranian had mouth pain that required extractions and spadina animal hospital took very good care of her. she recovered fast and is feeling great. we felt confident and well informed throughout the process even though this was our first time dealing with dental problems and this was our first time visiting the clinic. thank you.
Incredibly helpful and kind! Thank you so much for your help this weekend.

I found this vet while searching online, and choosing the right place for your loved pet is never easy. In my case, the experience was great from start to finish. The front desk staff go above and beyond when it comes to answering questions and addressing concerns

If I could make one suggestion, it would be to email the intake form to first time clients so it can be completed digitally in advance. Filling it out in person can be challenging when you have an active dog like mine

If you’re a Latino pet owner, I truly recommend this clinic. Dr. Mayra can assist you in both English and Spanish, and she took the time to clearly explain prices, recommendations, and options. She is very dedicated to your pet’s needs and never tries to push unnecessary products or services

Considering it’s a downtown clinic, the prices are fair and reasonable, depending on the services your pet requires. Overall, a very positive experience

I had a really great experience at Spadina Animal Hospital. Dr. Pusong was kind, professional, and genuinely cared about my cat. He was very understanding that we were on a budget and walked me through multiple treatment options without any pressure. We felt supported and informed the whole time. We have also seen Dr Stewart and felt the same way. Thank you so much.
2nd time using this vet clinic. Somehow had an outstanding balance from the previous visit that I was not made aware of until after my pets appointment. Will not be returning.

Gave me lots of options but still were pushing unnecessary treatments. My dog was also treated for leptospirosis with her vaccines from Mexico. I inquired if she was covered. They said no, never checked her paperwork and gave her an unnecessary vaccine. In addition to this, they also charged me for an ear treatment that was not needed and the staff made a mistake but they were not budging on me paying for their mistake. If you're good at being on top of what's needed without the vet needing to check. You'll be fine. But if you're looking for a vet that pays attention, I wouldn't recommend this spot. Seems cheaper up front but overcharged in the end.

Very negative experience at this vet. Recently our pet died 3 days after visiting the vet as we were not told properly that it could be an emergency. Communication and compassion are significantly lacking. Huge lack of accountability taken on the part of the vet and the overall clinic. Based on previous reviews, this seems like a trend as there are similar issues happening. Met with the vet afterwords and it was almost like speaking to a rehearsed script. Had the audacity to say “we were able to accommodate you even though you came late to your appointment”. I do wish they didn’t accommodate us because then we would have gone somewhere else and our cat may still be alive today. Please avoid if all possible if you suspect your pet may be sick. Stick to them for basics like vaccinations.

Everyone, from the receptionist to the doctor, was friendly. I highly recommend Spadina Animal Hospital to my friends.
Her vet is Dr. Luke, who is very professional, polite, straightforward with pricing, and you can see that he really takes care of the patient.
Reliable and trustworthy

Pet passed away in the ER two days after a visit to this vet. During my visit, the vet said there was nothing to worry about despite obvious signs.

They called me the following week to follow-up on the original appointment where I notified them of the passing. They said they would get review the results from the ER and get back to me with more details. They never got back to me.
Spadina Animal Hospital is amazing. Our dog is not a fan of the vet (to put it mildly) and the vets and techs are so incredibly patient and kind. They go above and beyond.

I’m extremely disappointed with the care my cat received at this clinic by Dr. Guirguis. My cat had a known history of heart murmur. When I brought him in with an enlarged abdomen & decline in appetite, the vet completely downplayed my concerns and dismissed it as “food sensitivity” and gassy stomach. No proper diagnostics were recommended, and the obvious symptoms of heart failure were ignored. Unfortunately, my cat passed away less than 48 hours after the vet visit due to a saddle thrombus. At the emergency vet, we were informed that his abdomen was filled with fluid, not gas like Dr. Guirguis insisted.

This isn’t the first issue, either. Previously, when my cat needed a stool sample, the clinic sent me results for the wrong cat. This is an alarming mistake that made me question their overall reliability.

I truly regret not seeking second opinions earlier before my cat’s condition worsened. I can’t recommend this clinic based on the repeated carelessness.
Staff is always friendly and helpful. All the vets that work here are knowledgable, they take time to answer all questions
Great Staff And Vets. Thank You So Much!

My experience with Spadina Animal Hospital from two years ago was quite disappointing. My cat had what looked like an obvious infection, and I had to specifically request a blood panel since they did not suggest it themselves. The person we got our cat from took one look at the blood panel results and pointed out it looked like an infection. We even mentioned this to the vets at Spadina, but they still did not prescribe antibiotics or address the infection.

The main recommendations Spadina gave us were to try feeding my cat wet food to encourage him to eat, and to give him an anti-nausea injection. There was no real plan for treating the root cause of the problem. Over several days, we kept coming back for different tests, but were left without clear guidance or a sense of urgency.

After all of this, we got a call from Spadina right before closing on a Saturday. The doctor basically told me that what my cat might have was very bad and he might not make it, without giving any real explanation or details. All I was told was that I could take him to the ER if I wanted. This left me in shock, in tears, and completely devastated. No one answered when I tried to call back because they waited until the last minute to make the call.

My cat’s condition had continued to get worse by then, so we went to the ER. The vets there quickly reviewed his test results and explained that what Spadina found alarming was actually normal based on how the sample was collected. He received the treatment he needed, only had to spend one night in the hospital, and made a full recovery. Two years later, he is still healthy, but that is thanks to the ER, not Spadina.

Looking back, all of this stress could have been avoided if Spadina had started treatment for the infection instead of just running more tests. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this clinic.

Poor service. My dog passed away after they heavily sedated him for an ultrasound. I never received the results- till one week after. My dog was already gone. Very good at hooking you as a patient everything transactional. Rude receptionist.

Spadina animal hospital 125 Spadina ave
The staff is polite and doctors are really gentle with pets   I have never had an issue
Great place to bring your pets.
Cat RICH Protector. Thank you for your kind care^-^
Amazing doctors and technicians that can handle emergency situations on the spot. They fixed my cat's dislocated jaw and performed an emergency procedure during her spay.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive rating. Thank you for choosing us, Sayani!

we spent a lot of money on the previous doctor
Until we changed for doctor Chu ( she is the best)

This vet is money hungry and will tell you whatever it takes for you to give them more money. Basically told me my cat was going to die and I had to prepare myself when he was NOT at all sick like that. If you care about your animal do not go here. And obviously my cat is doing amazing and thriving. He had a kitty cold nothing more
Thank you for the rating! We appreciate your trust in us and are always here to provide the best care for your furry family members
Greg is a very helpful person. went out of his way to help me and my friends who rescued an animal. thank you.

I went to Spadina Animal Hospital for a second opinion on my cat's allergies. I did not have any issues with the receptionist. They were very helpful and submitted my insurance claim for me as I had Trupanion. Also, everything was clean and the technicians were patient and friendly.

I saw Dr. Luke and he was very thorough and patient with me. He did not rush through the appointment, ensured I understood all of his recommendations, and even answered questions I had after the appointment through email. He also was transparent on the pricing of each test and medication.

Only thing is that I do recommend purchasing your own cone rather than at the vet. It was $17 for a plastic one.

Avoid Dr. Guirguis at all costs. Rushed the appointment and misdiagnosed my dog’s condition and ended up having to revisit for additional care. If you go, book for Dr. Stewart only.

Front desk staff could use some additional training. Booked an appointment with Dr. Stewart specifically via phone but ended up having to come back in two hours later due to scheduling conflicts. Had to remind them multiple times to get the invoice sent to my email. Poor ability with sending reminder instructions on diet prep prior to surgery.
The experience exceeded my expectations. The vet took a lot of time, carefully explained everything, found issues I wasn't aware of and I felt my cat received excellent care.

I had a horrible experience at this veterinarian office and would never recommend it to anyone who cares about their pet’s health and safety. While the exterior looks somewhat presentable, the inside tells a completely different story — it’s dirty, run-down, and downright unsanitary. I was shocked at how filthy everything looked, and honestly didn’t feel comfortable leaving my pet there. If the front looks that bad, I can only imagine the condition of the surgical tools and how they store medications — probably expired and never sanitized.

On top of that, their communication is terrible. I had to call multiple times — at least 5 attempts before anyone answered. When they finally did, the staff were rude and completely unprofessional. The male receptionist smelled like cigarette smoke and the women was eating food right at the front desk. That’s just disgusting and completely unhygienic in a medical setting, especially one that deals with animals.

This place needs a serious inspection. I left feeling uneasy and worried for the pets being treated there. Do yourself a favour and take your beloved animals somewhere that actually respects health standards and customer care. Avoid this place at all costs.

Mayra was wonderful, thank you !
We hopeful not to be back lol
They take really good care of our pets!! Lovely place to go

We found a lost dog on the street and took him here. The vets checked for microchip and contacted the owner right away. They also brushed the dog, checked for fleas, and gave him some water and treats. Wanted to leave this review to thank them for taking such good care of the lost dog :)

We have been regularly going to Spadina Animal Hospital for over 2 years now. Our dog loves visiting even though it often ends with a jab on his bum! Everyone - from the reception to the doctor - is extremely friendly, helpful and reassuring whenever I’ve come here (and I’ve often come during distress). So all in all - highly recommend
Highly Recommend!!

My cat needed urgent treatment during COVID and i must have spoken to 10 different Vetinary practices including my own vet and the VCA Emergency hospital. None of them could make space to see my little buddy, SAH was my last try and the only practice that was kind enough to accomodate him that sane day. The vet was kind, patient and thorough in his examination/investigation into what was going on. They also didn’t gouge me unlike    my useless regular vet at the time. I now have a puppy and his regular vet is SAH. A genuine love for animals is very much apparent in the whole team, not least the staff who work on reception!

Yesterday my elderly mother called me in a panic that her dog couldn't stand or see straight. Ran over to take them to the emergency vet, as the dog seemed very unwell. While waiting for an uber I called Spadina Animal Hospital and they offered to have him come in there right away to be looked at before waiting hours at the emergency clinic. Dr Stewart was incredibly thorough with the dog and clearly explained what the different causes could be and their likely expenses etc. But the best guess from he and his colleague was marijuana poisoning (likely a weed gummy etc on a walk) and, while clearly explaining the risks, recommended waiting a day before going to the emergency room and seeking out a neurologist. Today the dog is much better, he's dozey, but eating and drinking again and walking in a straight line! Dr Stewart and the Spadina Animal Hospital team gave us great detailed, empathetic care and saved us thousands of dollars too. The Best!

Dr. Luke and the front desk staff are always fantastic with my cat, and I trust the information and care provided. I’ve never been pressured to go with a certain treatment, and feel the staff genuinely care. The pricing is fair, erring on affordable considering the level of care they provide.

Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your trust in us and are always here to provide the best care for your furry family members. 🐾
 …

An honest review from a seven-year dog owner with Spadina Animal Hospital.

If you asked me 2-3 years ago, I would’ve given this clinic 4 stars. When we first started coming here around 2018, everything ran smoothly—appointments weren’t rushed, the vet (I believe it was Dr. Juliana at the time) explained things thoroughly, and we felt confident bringing our dog in whenever something came up.

However, in the past 2–3 years, the quality of care has noticeably declined. Every appointment has felt rushed, and our dog, who never needed a muzzle under Dr. Juliana’s care, now often does.

What ultimately led us to leave was a recent misdiagnosis. Our dog had a large bump on her toe, and during the appointment, the vet never touched or closely examined the area. He observed it from a distance while I lifted my dog paw for him to see. The entire visit lasted less than five minutes, he suspected the cause was interdigital cyst and we were sent home with antibiotics and steroids.

After 10 days with no improvement, we went to a second vet for opinion. The new vet immediately suspected a mast cell tumor, performed a biopsy on the spot, and confirmed it. Had we not gone elsewhere, our dog’s tumor could have gone undiagnosed and potentially spread further.

While I understand that misdiagnoses can happen, what I found unacceptable was the lack of basic examination. We lost valuable time, spent $500, and risked our dog’s health.

The staff there have always been kind and helpful, and I appreciate their support over the years. But based on the recent pattern of rushed appointments, lack of clear communication, and misdiagnosis, I can no longer recommend this clinic.

Transferred care for my dogs from another vet and couldn’t be happier. The doctors have been incredibly friendly, helpful, thorough. The staff are very responsive and detail oriented. Both Dr G and Dr Stewart have seen my pups and both have been exceptional. Can’t recommend this clinic enough!
I liked the friendly environment and prompt appointment for the boss of the house, my cat. Dr. Guirguis is very knowledgeable and took his time to explain what we were dealing with.
Dr. Luke was thorough, kind, and handled my cat’s condition with care and clarity. Also bonus points he’s very handsome
Great experience. The staff are attentive and polite. Dr Luke is great. He explains everything and answers all the doubts. Sunny and I were satisfied =)

This was a while ago but my kitten was not pooping for some days so we were trying to find a vet who could take them in for a checkup. We contacted Spadina Animal Hospital as our usual vet was filled up. We mentioned my kitten was constipated and they asked us to bring in a poop sample?? But the issue was that he couldn't poop 😂 we appreciated that they could fit us in on the same day but we decided not to go since we found the request strange.
They upsell on unnecessary procedures. My cat was misdiagnosed and unfortunately passed. Do not recommend at all
Very professional and fast help. Very friendly. Seems a bit more expensive than other vet clinics in the neighborhood. But the quality makes up for it.

Please read this before bringing your pet here.

I wish I didn’t have to write this, but my experience at this clinic has left me deeply frustrated and disappointed.

When I first brought my newly adopted puppy in for a checkup, I saw Dr. Luke Stewart, who was compassionate, thorough, and took his time reviewing my puppy’s history. My partner and I felt reassured that our puppy was receiving excellent care. The receptionists and vet techs were also incredibly kind and professional. If this review were based only on those experiences, it would be five stars.

Unfortunately, things changed when I was seen by Dr. Albert Guirguis. From the moment he walked in, the appointment felt rushed and impersonal. He immediately misidentified my puppy’s sex without even checking his records—an incredibly basic detail. He also claimed my puppy’s teeth weren’t developing properly, which caused me unnecessary worry until I got a second opinion confirming everything was normal. His entire exam lasted mere minutes, yet I was charged the full exam fee. It felt like he wanted to get me out of the room as quickly as possible.

The worst experience happened when my puppy accidentally ate a tiny piece of grape. Knowing that grapes can be toxic to dogs, I called the clinic immediately. I was grateful they fit me in right away, but unfortunately, Dr. Guirguis was again assigned to my case. When he came into the room, he spoke to me for about a minute before making a sweeping statement that “only 5% of dogs are affected” and then immediately saying my dog was in that 5%—without any tests or further discussion. They induced vomiting, but when they handed my puppy back to me, he was covered in feces—which I discovered when it got directly onto my hand. I completely understand that vets and vet techs have more important tasks than cleaning animals, but handing a pet back to their owner in that condition is simply unacceptable.

Dr. Guirguis then recommended bloodwork for three days straight to monitor kidney function. However, because the clinic is closed Sundays, we could only do two days, which was unavoidable. What was avoidable was the complete lack of communication. On Saturday, I specifically requested my puppy’s results via email because I had back-to-back meetings all day. They assured me they would send it, yet I never received anything. When I called later that evening, they had already closed, leaving me to spend the entire weekend anxious and uncertain about my puppy’s health.

When I returned on Monday, I expressed my frustration, and thankfully, the clinic had Dr. Stewart go over the results with me. He was kind and professional as always, and I appreciated that effort. But by then, the stress and disappointment I had experienced over the weekend were impossible to ignore.

I genuinely hate leaving this one-star review because there are wonderful staff members here—Emma, Divya, and Greg deserve recognition for their kindness and professionalism. But at the end of the day, I cannot in good conscience recommend this clinic to other pet owners. The lack of thoroughness, poor communication, and impersonal approach left me feeling like my pet was just another number rather than a living being who deserved proper care.

If you do choose this clinic, request an appointment with Dr. Stewart or another vet who will take the time to treat your pet with the attention they deserve.

I recently visited Spadina Animal Hospital with my dog, Abao, for an issue related to his anal area. While the clinic may work well for some pets, I believe it’s important to share my experience, especially for those with anxious pets, so you can make an informed decision.

1. Challenges with Anxious Pets:
•	My dog is very anxious at the vet, which I clearly explained to the veterinarian during our visit. While he is a large dog and visibly nervous, he was under my control the entire time and showed no aggression.
•	Unfortunately, the vet seemed hesitant to approach or examine him thoroughly because of his anxious behavior. Instead, they stood at a distance, briefly observed him, and initially suggested that allergies might be the issue without performing a close examination.
•	It was only after I insisted that my dog had no history of allergies that the diagnosis shifted to anal gland inflammation, but even then, the examination felt rushed and incomplete.

2. Lack of Thorough Examination:
•	My dog has a lot of hair around his anal area, but the vet did not check carefully for possible open wounds, abscesses, or other underlying causes. This lack of a detailed examination left me uncertain about the accuracy of the diagnosis.

3. Limited Guidance and Follow-Up:
•	After the gland expression procedure, I was prescribed antibiotics and ointment but received no advice on whether further treatment might be necessary or what to do if the symptoms didn’t improve.
•	It wasn’t until I reached out to the clinic days later that I was advised to return for a fecal test, which ultimately came back negative for parasites. However, even after the test, there was no follow-up or alternative plan suggested to address my dog’s persistent symptoms.

4. Key Takeaway for Pet Owners:
•	If your pet is calm and cooperative at the vet, this clinic might be a good choice. However, if your dog is anxious, nervous, or requires a more hands-on approach, my experience suggests that you might want to consider this carefully before booking an appointment. Managing anxious pets should be part of a veterinarian’s skill set, but in my case, it felt like my dog’s anxiety prevented a thorough examination and proper care.

While the costs at this clinic are reasonable, the lack of a detailed examination, proactive communication, and guidance for anxious pets left me feeling disappointed. I hope my experience helps other pet owners make an informed decision about whether this clinic is the right fit for their pet’s needs.

Several months ago I took my 3 month old corgi in to this clinic and met with Dr Mayra Gonzalez when I noticed a blue cloudy spot forming in one of my puppy's eye. I was assured that it was a corneal scratch received during his time with his litter, and that it wouldn't grow or impair his vision. What my dog actually had was a corneal edema that Dr Mayra Gonzalez misdiagnosed, and the result of that was my 3 month old puppy rapidly went blind in one eye. A corneal edema is a time sensitive condition that needs to be treated immediately. Had this condition not been misdiagnosed, he likely would have made a full recovery. Corneal edemas are very rare but documented conditions that can arise from vaccinations during puppyhood.This information is readily available on the vaccine manufacturer's website. Dr Mayra Gonzalez had been the one to give my puppy the vaccine in question. How she didn't know about the side effects is a very clear example of medical malpractice and incompetence. In the same appointment she warned me that my puppy was aggressive and underweight. Neither of these things have turned out to be true, both from my assessment and the vets that I've seen since then. She also blamed the dog for squirming during the examination and that she "couldn't get a good look at the eye" because of it. I'm sorry, but you're a vet. Dogs, especially puppies, squirm-- it comes with the job. None of the vets that I have taken him to since then have made the same complaint. I was very naive in thinking that all vets are the same, and giving Spadina Animal Hospital a fair chance. Not only has my puppy gone blind in one eye, there's a very real chance that he could very well lose the eye altogether- it's a ticking time bomb. It's a fear that I live with every day. This entire experience has been deeply upsetting and stressful, and now even several months out from this incident I continue struggle with the emotional impact. My puppy going blind has affected my relationship not just with my dog, but also anyone who might want to interact with him. Don't be like me. Go to a better facility. I thought that I was going in for a routine procedure and  it became anything but. I have attached a photo of my dog for view. The lighting isn't great but you can clearly make out the edema.

As a result I must try to limit how often we must visit and, to the extent I have any control over it, how long we stay. One way masking is good but not perfect—a lot of risk still remains when in a small space with many unmasked people.

Staff are generally great EXCEPT I have on multiple occasions encountered obviously ill (sniffles, coughs, runny noses) staff members who, despite being sick, were still unmasked. Completely irresponsible and very disappointing. I do understand that not everyone can take time off for what is or feels like a mild illness, but is it not the bare minimum now to mask up and keep illnesses from spreading to your customers? Or, in the interest of the business, your coworkers?

Anyways, my point is, the staff are great and I’m generally pleased with the care provided over the years (10?) that we have been customers, but as someone who badly needs to avoid respiratory illness, I do not feel safe being inside the clinic.
